title: 服装
cue:
Describe an piece of clothing you like.
You should say：
what it is
what it looks like
when you wear it
and explain why you like it.
a:
准备这道题的好处是：如果准备旗袍（chi-pao）或者唐装（Tang suit），就可以把 Describe your favourite traditional clothing（传统服装）. Describe a traditional product（传统产品）in your country. 和 Describe an occasion when you wore your favourite clothes.（穿最喜欢的服装的场合）这3个“不按常理出牌”的难题也一起解决了。

说唐装和旗袍会有一些相似的内容，但唐装比较宽松（loose-fitting），它的效果主要是让男士看起来更富贵（look wealthy and important），而旗袍则是紧身的（close-fitting），它的效果主要是让女士看起来更优雅（elegant）。我们以旗袍为例来说明怎样用地道的英文描述传统服装。

Pat的答案

I’m going to talk about my chi-pao, which was a birthday present from my parents.

Basically, it’s a close-fitting dress. But it looks quite special because it’s made from silk which is smooth and shiny. The short sleeves, the colourful pattern and the slits on the sides also make it look unique.

I only wear my chi-pao on special occasions. For example, I wear it during Spring Festival celebrations and at formal parties, such as business parties. I also wore it at my best friend’s wedding last year.

I like it because it fits me well. It is easy to slip on and comfortable to wear as well. I like it also because it looks festive and elegant, and makes me feel special and confident.
vocab: 服装侧面的窄缝，“开气儿”
有节日气氛的（它是 festival 的形容词形式）
毛衣（正面不带扣子的毛衣）
毛衣（正面有一排扣子的毛衣）
适合春秋穿的长袖运动衫
BURBERRY / FENDI / CHANEL / GUCCI / CHOLE / HERMES / BVLGARI / LOUIS VUITTON / SALVATORE FERRAGAMO / VERSACE / DOLCE&GABBANA / MARC JACOBS / ANNA SUI / SWAROVSKI / GIVENCHY
很容易被读错的时尚名牌

title: 交通工具之 汽车
cue:
Describe a vehicle you’d like to own.
You should say：
what the vehicle is
what it is like
whether it would be expensive to buy
and explain why you’d like to own it.
a:
I’m going to describe a car that I’d like to own, which is a Subaru Forester. It’s a car that not only looks good but also performs well.

The outside of the car looks sporty and attractive, and the build quality feels solid.

The inside is spacious and practical. The headroom and legroom are perfect for me, and there’s a lot of cargo room in the back. The handling of the car is also very good.

I’d like to own a Forester because it looks attractive and it’s fun to drive. Also, it has comfortable seats and plenty of cargo space. But it costs much less than a luxury SUV like a BMW X3 or an Audi Q5. So it’s good value for money.

I test-drove a Forester last week and was very impressed with it. I’m quite sure I’ll buy one later this year or sometime next year.
vocab: 车身的工艺（注意：在这个固定短语里不要用 building）
腿部的活动空间（这两个词里的 room 不是指房间而是指空间）
车的各项功能非常齐全
豪华车，高端车（固定短语）
